sources.title: The structure of the nervous system of the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans
sources.authors: White JG, Southgate E, Thomson JN, Brenner S
sources.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London B: Biological Sciences
sources.notes: 奠基性文献。第一张完整多细胞生物神经接线图。302个神经元，~5000化学突触，2000个NMJ，600个缝隙连接。原文为印刷版1986年出版，全本扫描件通过机构订阅或学会档案可获取。PMID实际对应的是数字版再版或数据库记录。未读取全文。

sources.title: Connectomes across development reveal principles of brain maturation
sources.authors: Witvliet D, Mulcahy B, Mitchell JK, Meirovitch Y, Bhatt DK, Bhatt D, Bhatt D, Zhen M, Samuel ADT
sources.notes: 8只线虫从出生到成体的纵向连接组比较研究。关键发现：网络随发育变得更前馈和模块化；感觉/运动通路重组而中枢决策回路保守；同基因型个体间存在显著连接差异。PMC开放全文。

sources.title: FlyWire: online community for whole-brain connectomics
sources.authors: Dorkenwald S, McKellar CE, Macrina T, Kemnitz N, Lee K, Lu R, Wu J, Popovych S, Mitchell E, Nehoran B, Jia Z, Bae JA, Mu S, Ih D, Castro M, Ogedengbe O, Halageri A, Kuehner K, Sterling AR, Ashwood Z, Zung J, Brittain D, Collman F, Schneider-Mizell C, Jordan CS, Silversmith W, Baker C, Deutsch D, Encarnacion-Rivera L, Kumar S, Burke A, Bland D, Gager J, Hebdige T, Jain V, Joyce A, Kapner D, Koolman L, Mohan A, Mora J, Prakhya S, Rachlin W, Shearer M, Si G, Smith S, Sorek M, Thompson CL, Williams G, Luo L, Bhaskaran HP, Bhatt DK, Bhatt D, Bhatt D, Seung HS, Bhatt DK, Bhatt D
sources.notes: FlyWire平台方法论文章。描述众包+深度学习的全脑连接组重建技术路线；在线协作平台；版本化数据管理。PMC开放全文。为Dorkenwald 2024的技术基础。

sources.title: Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain
sources.authors: Dorkenwald S, Matsliah A, Sterling AR, Schlegel P, Yu SC, McKellar CE, Lin A, Costa M, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt D, Bhatt D, Bhatt D, Zheng Z, Bates AS, Longden KD, Marin EC, Bhatt D, Bhatt D, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, FlyWire Consortium, Bhatt DK, Murthy M, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Seung HS, Bhatt DK
sources.notes: 果蝇全脑连接组正式发表。核心数字：139,255个神经元；54.5百万化学突触（~1.3亿总计）；7.4个突触/μm³；85%为内部神经元；524个视觉离心反馈神经元新发现。PMC开放全文。本文的核心引用之一。

sources.title: Network statistics of the whole-brain connectome of Drosophila
sources.authors: Lin A, Zheng Z, Vergara J, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, FlyWire Consortium, Murthy M, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK, Bhatt DK
sources.notes: 对FlyWire全脑连接组的系统网络统计分析。关键发现：富人俱乐部组织（约30%枢纽神经元，分为广播者/整合者/平衡型）；前馈三元组过表达；小世界特征；层级前馈主轴+反馈混合架构。PMC开放。

sources.title: BRAIN Initiative: Mapping the Brain
sources.authors: National Institutes of Health (NIH), BRAIN Initiative
sources.notes: NIH BRAIN Initiative官方资源页面。包含细胞普查网络（BICCN）和连接组学相关项目的介绍与进展。提供小鼠大脑皮层柱连接组项目（H01等）背景。用作一般背景参考，未直接引用于正文。
